request_notes: V3 uses statusCode 200; historical v1 uses status.code Success. Business failures are not accepted based on HTTP status alone.
Historical modifyNetworkAttribute and modifyVSwitchAttribute overview titles are swapped. Their VPC/subnet request identity fields and URI names establish the corrected visible command meanings.
Subnet IPv6 update API 16272 is a documented v3 exception retaining the status.code Success/data response envelope; do not infer its contract from the URI generation.

Image name and image ID are documented alternatives despite an unconditional required marker on imageName; both remain optional in usage with the either/or requirement in help and upstream validation.
Historical PASSWD login requires a password; SSH login no longer fails a contradictory unconditional password requirement. System disk size remains conditional on the chosen specification.

notes: Order status documents named terminal states, but the captured example uses numeric 0 without a mapping; no order-completion waiter is inferred.
Disk, EIP, NAT, snapshot and peering terminal states are not established by the captured schemas; creation response success only confirms the request.
Backend membership and health-check status labels lack terminal enum evidence.
No wait-for-deletion command is inferred when the detail API may stop returning the deleted resource.
